title: Sage S2.1 Flash Technical Report
abstract: arXiv:2611.21072v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce Sage S1.5 Flash, a 320-billion-parameter general-purpose mixture-of-experts model designed to reason over scientific evidence and act in interactive environments. Sage Sci-Perception uses dedicated encoders for molecular graphs and biological sequences and represents spectra as ordered patches of measurements. Modality-specific projectors map these representations into the input space of a shared backbone, which processes them alongside text and images. To develop the model's agent capabilities, we construct verifiable environments for tool use, search, and coding, as well as specialized workflows involving machine learning experiments and scientific software. Task completion is checked against execution results, changes in environment state, or submitted artifacts. We evaluate Sage S1.5 Flash on 33 benchmarks across seven domains. In the primary comparison against five baselines, it ranks first on OfficeQA Pro (72.2), MLE-b

translated_title: Sage S2.1 Flash 技术报告
translated_abstract: 我们推出了 Sage S1.5 Flash，这是一个拥有 3200 亿参数的通用混合专家模型，旨在对科学证据进行推理并在交互式环境中执行行动。Sage Sci-Perception 采用专用的编码器处理分子图和生物序列，并将光谱表示为有序的测量值片段。各模态专属的投影器将这些表示映射到共享主干网络的输入空间中，主干网络将其与文本和图像一同处理。为了培养模型的智能体能力，我们构建了用于工具使用、搜索和编程的可验证环境，以及涉及机器学习实验和科学软件的专用工作流。任务完成情况根据执行结果、环境状态变化或提交的产物进行核验。我们在七个领域的 33 个基准上对 Sage S1.5 Flash 进行了评估。在与五个基线模型的主要对比中，它在 OfficeQA Pro（72.2）和 MLE-b（原文此处被截断）上排名第一。
tldr: 提出了 3200 亿参数的通用混合专家模型 Sage S1.5 Flash，具备跨分子图、生物序列、光谱等科学数据的感知能力，并通过可验证环境训练出工具使用、搜索、编程等智能体能力，在七个领域 33 个基准评测中表现领先。
en_tdlr: We present Sage S1.5 Flash, a 320B-parameter mixture-of-experts model with dedicated scientific perception encoders and agent capabilities trained in verifiable environments, ranking first across 33 benchmarks in seven domains.
